text: dsh-bundle-vision 是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 增加图片理解能力的工具插件，并通过 bundle patch 将插件挂载到 DSH profile。它注册 describe_image 工具，读取本地 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 图片，经附件服务保存后，调用用户指定的多模态 provider 和 model 处理提示词，并把模型生成的文字作为结果返回。可用于识别图片文字、描述图像内容或进行分类；即使主模型本身只能处理文本，也可通过该工具询问图片。使用前需在 DSH 的 Models 设置中配置多模态模型路由，并声明模型支持图片输入。

dsh-bundle-vision adds the describe_image tool to DSH. It reads local PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF images, sends them with a prompt to a selected multimodal model, and returns text for description, OCR, or classification. Configure an image-capable model route in DSH Settings → Models.
让 DSH 帮我读出本地图片里的文字。
我想用只能聊天的主模型询问一张图片内容。
Can DSH describe a local image using a multimodal model I choose?
dsh-bundle-vision 的功能「图片问答」：通过 describe_image 工具指定本地图片路径、问题和多模态 provider/model，读取 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF 图片并返回模型的文字回答。
dsh-bundle-vision 的功能「为文本模型使用视觉能力」：主模型调用工具并指定支持图片输入的模型路由，插件把图片和提示词交给该路由，最终只将文字答案返回到工具结果中。
dsh-bundle-vision 使用前须知：图片和提示词会发给所选多模态模型；服务由部署者配置的路由决定，密钥配置在 provider 设置中。

dsh-bundle-vision README · dsh-bundle-vision：The tool reads a local PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file, commits the bytes through the shipped attachment service, and asks the **named** multimodal route about it in one direct LLM request (`provider` / `model` are tool arguments). The result is text only — no image block ever enters the calling session, so a text-only main model gains vision without any change to dsh itself.

section: How it works against the shipped seams

text:
dsh-bundle-vision README · How it works against the shipped seams：The one per-deployment prerequisite is the same as for any vision use of dsh: the multimodal model must declare image input in the `llm-pi-ai` settings section, e.g.:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-vision:
      apiKeyEnv: MY_VISION_API_KEY

(On releases whose Models page has the input-modality control, the same declaration is one dropdown.)

text:
dsh-bundle-vision README · Install (installed dsh, no source checkout)：From the npm registry:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-bundle-vision
```

Or from a packed tarball (e.g. before the first publish, or for a pinned version):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-bundle-vision-0.1.0.tgz
```

dsh-bundle-vision README · Install (installed dsh, no source checkout)：`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and reconciles the profile's bundle layers automatically — a dependency declaring `dsh.bundle` joins the layer stack. Restart `dsh <name>`; the tool registers for every agent (profile-root registrations are visible to all preset scopes).

dsh-bundle-vision README · Use：Ask the main model, naming the route:

> Use describe_image with file_path `/path/to/photo.jpg`, provider `my-vision`, model `my-vision-model`, and prompt "OCR the text in this image".

The main model supplies provider/model per call — configure several multimodal routes and switch per call, no profile edits. Refusals name the failing gate (unknown extension, deployment media types, a route whose model does not declare image input, a missing file, a type-mismatched file, an errored stream).
dsh-bundle-vision README · Version floor：The package declares `>=0.1.0-rc.6` peer dependencies on the dsh seam packages. Bump the floor if a later release is required.
